name: warden_of_evos_isle_pays_full_cost_for_itself
notes: Printed: 'Flying. Creature spells with flying you cast cost {1} less to cast.' ({2}{U}). A permanent's static ability functions only on the battlefield (CR 113.6), so the Warden being cast pays its full cost; one on the battlefield discounts the next. Found by the M20 round-2 verifier (2026-11-05). Two mana is not enough for the Warden in hand.
